events.speaker: INES
events.text: Hear that bell? No cow attached. That's usually a clue.

events.speaker: INES
events.text: Hoofprints going both ways. Somebody wants us lost.

events.speaker: INES
events.text: Cold ashes, fresh smoke. The fire's remembering.

events.speaker: INES
events.text: Watch the shadow. It's the only honest thing here.

events.speaker: INES
events.text: There. A perfectly ordinary impossible trail.

events.speaker: INES
events.text: I'll scout ahead. Try to keep up with the living.

events.speaker: INES
events.text: You noticed me before the ghost. Good priorities.

events.speaker: INES
events.text: Man offers you his lantern by a fire, don't take it. He's been offering the same one for longer than he'd like to say.

events.speaker: INES
events.text: Bellhollow's bell isn't mine to read. I've heard it once. I didn't go back for a second opinion.
